flows.name: A team turns its manual tests into automation and decides whether to ship (Qase)
flows.summary: Qase's home page: "you'll never have to ask: Are we good to ship? You'll know." It calls its AI "Qase AI", not an agent, so no step here is marked as an agent's.

steps.what: Has a backlog of manual test cases that are re-run by hand before every release.
Converts a manual test case into a Playwright, Cypress or Selenium script: paste a test case, pick a framework, see the script.
Brings CI results, manual runs and framework output into one dashboard, a system of record for automated and manual results.
Maps every requirement to its test cases and results, so what was asked can be traced to what was verified.
Makes the go or no-go decision on a readiness report built from that data.
